title: One-pot native barcoding of amplicons v2
author: Josh Quick
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bdp8i5rw

steps.title: Prepare End Prep Reaction
steps.instruction: Set up the following reaction for each sample in a tube:

substeps.instruction: Add 5 µL PCR dilution from previous step
Add 7.5 µL Nuclease-free water
Add 1.75 µL Ultra II End Prep Reaction Buffer
Add 0.75 µL Ultra II End Prep Enzyme Mix (Total volume: 15 µL)

steps.title: Incubate End Prep Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform the following incubation sequence for the end prep reaction:

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 10 minutes
Incubate at 65 °C for 10 minutes
Incubate on ice for 1 minute

steps.title: Set Up Ligation Reaction
steps.instruction: In a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, set up the following reaction for each sample:

substeps.instruction: Add 1.5 µL of the previous reaction mixture
Add 5.7 µL Nuclease-free water
Add 2.5 µL NBXX barcode (Use one native barcode from EXP-NBD104 (1-12) or EXP-NBD114 (13-24) per sample; use 6 to 24 barcodes per library)
Add 10 µL Ultra II Ligation Master Mix
Add 0.3 µL Ligation Enhancer (Total volume: 20 µL)

steps.title: Incubate Ligation Reaction
steps.instruction: Perform the following incubation sequence for the ligation reaction:

substeps.instruction: Incubate at room temperature for 20 minutes
Incubate at 65 °C for 10 minutes to inactivate DNA ligase
Incubate on ice for 1 minute

steps.title: Pool Barcoding Reactions
steps.instruction: Pool all 20 µL one-pot barcoding reactions together in a new 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.

steps.title: Bind Samples to SPRI Beads
steps.instruction: Add 0.4x volume of SPRI beads to the pooled sample tube (e.g., 96 µL beads for 240 µL of pooled reactions) and mix gently by flicking or pipetting.

substeps.instruction: Pulse centrifuge to collect all liquid at the bottom of the tube
Incubate for 5 minutes at room temperature
Place on magnetic rack and incubate for 2 minutes or until beads have pelleted and supernatant is completely clear
Carefully remove and discard the supernatant without touching the bead pellet

steps.title: Perform SFB Washes
steps.instruction: Wash the beads using SFB to remove excess adapter:

substeps.instruction: Add 700 µL SFB and resuspend beads completely by pipette mixing
Pulse centrifuge to collect all liquid at the bottom of the tube
Remove and discard the supernatant
Repeat the SFB addition, centrifugation, and supernatant removal steps for a second wash
Pulse centrifuge and remove any residual SFB

steps.title: Perform Ethanol Wash
steps.instruction: Perform a single 70% ethanol wash to clean the pellet:

substeps.instruction: Add 200 µL of room-temperature 70% volume ethanol to bathe the pellet
Carefully remove and discard ethanol without touching the bead pellet
Pulse centrifuge to collect all liquid and carefully remove as much residual ethanol as possible using a P10 pipette

steps.title: Dry and Elute DNA
steps.instruction: Dry the pellet and elute the final product:

substeps.instruction: Incubate with the tube lid open for 1 minute or until the pellet loses its shine (do not let it dry completely)
Resuspend pellet in 30 µL Elution Buffer (EB), mix gently by flicking or pipetting, and incubate for 2 minutes
Place on magnet and transfer the sample to a clean 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube, ensuring no beads are transferred
